result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop display designed for studio rooms, reading desks, and mixed-use home offices. The Orchid Lantern 27Q combines a matte IPS panel with a gentle HDR tuning profile, making it suited for document work, illustration, and relaxed video viewing rather than gaming or graphics-card workloads. It features a 2560 x 1440 resolution, 75 Hz refresh rate, USB-C input for laptop connectivity, and an adjustable stand for portrait or landscape use.
